items.summary: A four-hour documentary about Elon Musk continues to meet resistance from social media platforms.

items.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
items.summary: The composition of Anthropic’s workforce and the type of work getting done have changed significantly in the past year.

items.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
items.summary: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

items.title: Ember’s new temperature-controlled mug makes my nightly tea ritual even better
items.summary: The biggest change about Ember's new mug is that you no longer have to open the app to adjust your drink’s temperature.

items.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
items.summary: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, […]
